description: Get the UK rate/threshold in force for a key on a date (default today, Europe/London). Returns value, unit, effective dates and source. Paid: $0.005 USD per call via x402, or use an API key (see /pricing).

jurisdiction.description: Defaults to UK. Falls back to rUK/UK when no specific row exists.
